title: [BUG] PermissionDecision in PreToolUse is ignored in latest VS Code Extension
author: klunejko

top_comments.author: yurukusa
top_comments.body:
This is the same class of bug as #37210 — `permissionDecision: "deny"` is ignored for certain tool types.

**Workaround using chmod defense-in-depth:**

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# edit-guard.sh — makes file read-only before deny, so even if deny is ignored the write fails
INPUT=$(cat)
TOOL=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_name // empty')
FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty')

if [[ "$TOOL" == "Edit" || "$TOOL" == "Write" ]]; then
    if should_deny "$FILE"; then
        chmod 4

top_comments.author: Khodunov
top_comments.body: This is probably connected to the [PreToolUse hook permissionDecision no longer overrides ask rules](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/36059) issue, but with a VS Code Extension interface
